description: React 19 component library built on React Aria, with scoped light and dark styles including the contemporary Chinese Hepo and Hepo Interior themes.
rules: Import React components from @zixiao-labs/ui-kits-react. Import styles.css or base.css followed by the specific themes/<style>.css files, not both.
Set data-zx-style and data-zx-color-mode on the same scope element. Use hepo or hepo-interior for the native Hepo looks; themePresets are palette seeds, not style identifiers.
